H1_capability_interface_drift.evidence_for: Seed 2 (the negative persistence seed) exhibits greater relative L2 capability proposal drift at Layer 4 and lower observation CKA compared to positive persistence Seeds 1 and 3.
H1_capability_interface_drift.evidence_against: At Layer 2, capability proposal drift is moderately comparable across seeds.
H1_capability_interface_drift.limitations: Descriptive at n=3 seeds. Independent initialization offsets also contribute to baseline representation dynamics.

H2_functional_controller_drift.evidence_for: Seed 2 exhibits higher functional steering vector drift (Layer 4 steering relative L2) and larger gate absolute change despite theta_N being strictly bit-identical, showing that representation drift translates into functional controller perturbation.
H2_functional_controller_drift.evidence_against: Steering vector cosine similarity remains relatively high (>0.85) across all seeds.
H2_functional_controller_drift.limitations: Prompt-level variance within seeds is high; differences are visible in aggregate means.

H3_downstream_override_effect_loss.evidence_for: Ablation gap decreases in all seeds during persistence training.
H3_downstream_override_effect_loss.evidence_against: Seed 2 active/off causal gap does not collapse disproportionately relative to steering vector drift; rather, controller output itself drifted.
H3_downstream_override_effect_loss.limitations: Ablation gap is a single-token prompt-boundary proxy for multi-token generation.

H4_safety_acquisition_quality_selectivit.evidence_for: Pre-persistence safety refusal on OOD harmful was slightly higher in Seed 2 (84.4%) than Seed 1 (80.1%), indicating that failure to retain safety was not caused by poor initial safety acquisition.
H4_safety_acquisition_quality_selectivit.evidence_against: Initial pre-persistence refusal selectivity is high across all three seeds and does not linearly predict subsequent persistence delta.
H4_safety_acquisition_quality_selectivit.limitations: Only three seeds available; pre-persistence metrics are tightly clustered in the 80-85% range.

H5_generic_frozen_module_interface.evidence_for: Model D adapters also exhibit substantial input drift and residual drift across all 8 sites during persistence training, demonstrating that frozen modules attached to evolving backbones generically experience interface instability.
H5_generic_frozen_module_interface.evidence_against: Model D adapter retention in Seed 2 remained higher than Model C, indicating differing architectural sensitivity to interface drift.
H5_generic_frozen_module_interface.limitations: Model C and Model D have distinct parameterizations (multiplicative/additive controller vs. bottleneck adapters).
